samples.transcript: This is the bank fraud desk. Your account will be frozen in ten minutes unless you tell me the OTP that just arrived.
Our security workshop explains that a caller claiming your account will be frozen may demand an OTP. Never give them the code.
To reverse a suspicious payment, install the screen-sharing app I sent you and allow me to control your phone.
The bank employee explained where the dispute form is located. She did not ask for remote access, passwords, or verification codes.
I am an investigating officer. A criminal case has been filed against you. Stay on this call, tell nobody, and transfer the security deposit now.
In today's class we will examine fake police calls that threaten arrest and request a security deposit. These are warning signs, not instructions to pay.
Your electricity service will be disconnected tonight. Pay the overdue amount using this personal payment link immediately.
I received a normal electricity bill reminder. I checked the amount in the official provider app and scheduled payment for next week.
I work for the courier company. Your parcel is held. Send me your card number and security code so I can release it.
A courier company should not need your card security code to release a parcel. Report any caller who asks for that information.
You are under digital arrest. Do not contact your family. Keep your camera on while we investigate, and send the verification payment.
The officer explained that I could visit the station during office hours to verify the notice. No money, secrecy, or video call was required.
